description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000], [Aspiring Hero Mode] and [Hell Aero Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Aspiring Hero Mode
description.text: Keeps track of the number of Wind abilities used (0~4), grants [Aspiring Hero Critical Chance] after using a Wind ability

description.name: Aspiring Hero Critical Chance
description.text: Critical chance =0/25/50/75/100% scaling with [Aspiring Hero Mode], removed if user hasn't [Aspiring Hero Mode]

description.name: Hell Aero Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Hell Aero after using two Wind abilities

description.name: Hell Aero
description.text: Causes [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], causes [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] if Sephiroth is alive
